title: observability: add token-level CPU & memory metrics, Grafana dashboard and alert tuning
author: Priya Nair
description: Add token-level CPU and memory metrics to the serving runtime exporter, build a Grafana dashboard for token-level cost/latency breakdowns, and tune alerts to reduce noise while catching regressions. This PR adds new Prometheus metrics (redwood_token_cpu_seconds_total, redwood_token_memory_bytes, redwood_token_processing_latency_seconds) and exposes labels for model, route, node_id, batch_size, and token_index so the Console dashboards can show per-token cost and resource pressure. Motivation: recent incidents showed high per-token CPU/memory spikes that were not visible in existing per-request aggregates. This change improves visibility into memory growth across long sequences and enables alerting on token hotspots and KV cache pressure. Work included: runtime exporter changes, metrics unit tests, Grafana dashboard JSON and provisioning, updated alert rules, documentation updates for metric semantics and recommended thresholds, and a migration guide for customers using custom dashboards. Related Linear items ENG-4982 and ENG-5010.
